# Vision — Template

> **Inputs:** problem statement, research findings. **Outputs:** feeds Goals and Requirements.
> _Copy this file, delete the guidance in italics, and fill in the placeholders._

> **Purpose:** <one sentence — the future this project is trying to create>
> **Owner:** <role, e.g. Product Manager>
> **Written:** Vision stage. **Changes:** only on a strategic pivot.
> **Inputs:** Problem statement, Research. **Outputs:** Goals, Requirements.

## Problem

_What problem exists today, for whom, and why it matters. Two or three sentences, no solution yet._

## Vision statement

_One or two sentences describing the desired future state once this succeeds. Aspirational but concrete._

> Example: "Anyone can capture a task in under two seconds and trust it will still be there
> tomorrow, on any device, without an account."

## Who benefits

| Audience | What changes for them |
|----------|-----------------------|
| <primary user> | <the before → after> |
| <secondary user> | <the before → after> |

## Why now

_What makes this worth doing now — a shift in technology, market, cost, or need._

## What success looks like

_A short narrative of the world when this has worked. Turned into measurable targets in Goals._

## Non-goals

_What this project deliberately will **not** try to be. Guards against scope creep from day one._

## Assumptions & risks

- **Assumption:** <something we're taking as true> — _validated by …_
- **Risk:** <what could undermine the vision> — _mitigated by …_
